description: This file implements a registry system for template heuristics in PyTorch Inductor, including registration, retrieval, caching, and context management for overriding heuristics.

methods.name: register_template_heuristic
methods.description: Decorator to register template heuristic classes based on template name, device type, and operator name.

methods.name: get_template_heuristic
methods.description: Retrieves a heuristic instance for a given template, device type, and operator, using cache or fallback.

methods.name: get_registered_heuristic_class
methods.description: Returns the registered heuristic class for a specific template, device, and operator combination.

methods.name: clear_registry
methods.description: Clears all registered heuristics and cache, mainly for testing.

methods.name: override_template_heuristics
methods.description: Context manager to temporarily override heuristics for testing purposes.
